title: OpenModelica workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenModelica workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Open Source Modelica Consortium

OpenModelica

OpenModelica is an open-source environment for equation-based modelling and simulation of dynamic systems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Assemble a Modelica system

Start from the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended OpenModelica preview, assemble a Modelica system; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Simulate a transient case

Begin with the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended OpenModelica preview, simulate a transient case; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Plot and compare signals

Use the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended OpenModelica preview, plot and compare signals; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
